title: Neon Operation
description: A Neon operation tracks the progress of an action performed on a project resource such as creating a branch, starting a compute endpoint, or applying configuration changes.

project_id.description: The project ID this operation belongs to

branch_id.description: The branch ID associated with this operation, if applicable

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint ID associated with this operation, if applicable

action.description: The type of action being performed by this operation

status.description: The current status of the operation

failures_count.description: Number of times the operation has failed and been retried

error.description: Error message if the operation failed

created_at.description: Timestamp when the operation was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the operation status was last updated
